documents.title: Team Glossary
documents.content:
Team Glossary

OKR: Objectives and Key Results, the quarterly goal-setting framework used by the team.
RFC: Request For Comments, a written design proposal circulated before implementation.
Sev1: A production incident with customer impact that requires an immediate response.
DRI: Directly Responsible Individual, the single owner accountable for a task or decision.
